title: Airport Services Charging Rule for Checked Baggage on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Charging rule — checked baggage, Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.**

## Recording and counting

Every checked bag is recorded as a bag entry for its direction of travel, with an amount of zero when it falls inside the free allowance. The sequence of a bag is the number of first, second and third bag charges already recorded on the same ticket and direction, up to the moment of the charge, plus one; weight and size charges are not counted. The first bag checked in a direction is therefore the first bag even when bags are checked at different times.

## Free allowance

The free allowance is the fare brand's allowance for the itinerary class (domestic, short-haul international or long-haul international), compared with the passenger's Summit tier elite checked-bag allowance in the loyalty program's terms and, on a ticket with an active corporate agreement, the agreement tier's corporate checked-bag allowance; the single most generous allowance applies and allowances never add together.

## Sequence charges

A bag beyond the allowance is charged by its sequence. On domestic itineraries a first bag costs the fare brand's online first-bag fee when prepaid online or in the app and its airport first-bag fee when paid at the airport or through the call center, and a second bag costs the domestic second-bag fee.

The following clauses are **no longer in force** and are superseded by the current bag charge bases: the clause that on international itineraries the first and second bag fees for the itinerary class apply in every channel; and the clause that the third and each further bag costs the third-bag fee of domestic and short-haul itineraries or of long-haul itineraries.

## Weight and size charges

Weight and size charges are separate entries on the same bag and are added on top of the sequence charge, even for a bag inside the free allowance.

The following clauses are **no longer in force** and are superseded by the current weight-or-size charge basis: the clause that a bag heavier than the weight allowance up to the first band limit pays the first overweight band charge and a bag heavier than the first band limit up to the heaviest weight accepted pays the second overweight band charge; and the clause that a bag larger than the standard size up to the largest size accepted pays the oversize charge.

When a bag is both overweight and oversize only the higher of the two charges is recorded. A bag heavier than the heaviest weight accepted or larger than the largest size accepted is not accepted as checked baggage.

## Conditions

Bags are charged only while the ticket is ticketed or partially flown. A bag fee is refunded under the fee-refund rule when the bag is delivered late beyond the refund threshold.
